helpTopics.title: Choosing stages
helpTopics.keywords: order dependency prerequisites select decode states
helpTopics.answer: Core stages cover screening through activity. Select all stages to include model preparation and fitting. A partial run needs its earlier stages' caches.

helpTopics.title: Null shuffles through time
helpTopics.answer: The default shuffles labels independently at each bin. Enable Preserve null time structure to reuse a permutation across bins for each held-out trial and shuffle. Models remain separate at each bin, and permutations remain independent between held-out trials.

helpTopics.title: A fresh run or a rerun?
helpTopics.keywords: cache resume checkpoint folder overwrite history
helpTopics.answer: Use a new run directory when comparing analysis settings. Reusing a directory can replace stage outputs; manifest history is retained. Decoder checkpoints are reused only when their inputs and settings match.

helpTopics.title: Keep a reusable configuration
helpTopics.keywords: preset settings json save export import
helpTopics.answer: The form starts with the example settings. Copy settings from the JSON editor into a named configuration file, or use Reuse settings from a previous run.

helpTopics.title: Warnings and failed stages
helpTopics.keywords: error missing invalid failure help troubleshooting
helpTopics.answer: Open the stage log for the specific message. A completed pipeline can still contain model warnings or unavailable results; inspect fit diagnostics before interpreting them.

helpTopics.title: Export clear figures
helpTopics.keywords: pdf png tif eps vector lossless formats
helpTopics.answer: Choose PNG for inline previews and PDF for vector text and paths. The format selection applies to every stage; embedded images remain raster data inside a PDF.

helpTopics.title: Sessions and available data
helpTopics.keywords: data directory allowlist missing session list file
helpTopics.answer: The session list filters the files actually present in your data directory. Listed sessions without matching files are reported; available listed sessions continue.

helpTopics.title: Compare with the right context
helpTopics.keywords: compare split screen session run results settings
helpTopics.answer: Keep the analysis population, preferred cue, trial set, and preprocessing in view. Different settings can change what a figure or score represents.
